docs.title: 🚀 Mark Willoughby | Data Scientist | Machine Learning & Time Series Expert
docs.text: I am a Data Scientist with a strong foundation in Physics and a passion for Machine Learning, Time Series Analysis, and Algorithm Development. My expertise lies in transforming complex data into actionable insights, helping businesses make data-driven decisions efficiently.

docs.title: 🔬 Scientific Approach to Data & AI
docs.text: With experience in Wind Energy, Consultancy, and Asset Integrity Safety, I apply a scientific and problem-solving mindset to real-world challenges. My work involves designing ML models, predictive analytics, and scalable AI solutions for industries that rely on precision and automation.

docs.title: 📌 Data Scientist | M2hycon GmbH 💼📊 (Apr 2023 - Present)
docs.text:
• Developed failure detection algorithms for industrial clients using classification models and neural networks.
  • Built containerized services using Docker 🐳, Kubernetes ☸️, FastAPI ⚡, ensuring scalable deployment.
  • Designed real-time data pipelines and integrated Grafana 📡 for monitoring.
  • Wrote technical reports & blog posts on AI and ML applications.

docs.title: 📌 Data Scientist | Rosen GmbH 🦺🤖 (Dec 2020 - Mar 2023)
docs.text:
• Developed AI-driven navigation systems for autonomous water pipeline inspection robots using accelerometers, gyroscopes, and depth sensors.
  • Designed sensor fusion algorithms combining IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) data to improve robotic movement precision in complex pipeline environments.
  • Built machine learning models to detect obstacles, defects, and anomalies in pipeline infrastructure using ultrasound-based diagnostics.
  • Developed Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) 🚀, translating research into fully functional robotic navigation systems.

docs.title: 📌 Master Thesis | Enercon GmbH 🌬️🌀 (Sep 2019 - Jun 2020)
docs.text:
• Developed Lifting Line Theory model, reducing wind turbine development costs.
  • Analyzed and visualized 3D CFD simulation datasets using Python 🐍, TECplot 📊, ParaView 🌐.
  • Optimized workflows with Python scripting to improve wind turbine simulations.
